sentences.text:
Also heard Mr. Hari Om Rai,
 learned Panel Lawyer for the State.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the  petitioners that the private respondent/Complainant i Sister-in-law of the petitioner, who lodged the present report against the petitioner for the offence in question, the charge-sheet has been submitted and further the charges have been framed on 04/12/2021 by the trial Court vide Annexure P/2 and since then only two formal witnesses have been examined and private respondent No.2 has not appeared before the trial Court to get her deposition recorded and the trial Court has issued non- ASHUTOSH bailable warrant against her for her appearance and the MISHRA same is not being executed and lastly the date was fixed on 06/05/2025 and on the said date also the warrant could not be executed and she was not produced.
In view of the same it is submitted that the present proceedings are only malacious proceedings for the harassment of the petitioner.
Issue notice to the respondents by ordinary as well as registered posts.
Learned State counsel appears and accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 1, therefore, issuance of notice to them, is dispensed with.
Process fee be paid within a week only for respondent No. 2.
Notice be made returnable in four weeks.

Two weeks' time is granted to the learned State counsel as well as respondent No. 2 to file their reply- affidavit and thereafter, one week's time is granted to the Narendra Mahaut @ Nagesh Chandra Mahout vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83930549/
